en-US.description: QOwnNotes is the open source notepad with markdown support and todo list manager
en-US.name: QOwnNotes
en-US.releaseNotes:
26.11.5
- Raised the minimum supported Qt 5 version to 5.13, matching the oldest retained CI
  build, and removed the Qt 5.9 build job
  (related to #3752)
  - qmake and CMake now reject older Qt 5 versions during configuration
- Added Ubuntu 27.04 Tenacious T-Rex to the Qt6 Launchpad build script
- Line ending markers (¶) in the note editor now use the Whitespace marker color of the
  editor color scheme, like the markers for spaces and tabs
  (for #3840)
- Added tag support to the Nextcloud Deck dialog
  (for #3834)
  - Tags of the cards are shown as colored pills in the new Tags column of the card list,
    and the search also finds cards by their tags
  - The tags of a card are shown as colored chips in the card editor and can be removed
    with a click
  - Tags can be added via the Add tag button or Ctrl + T, which opens a searchable
    tag list of the board
  - New tags can be created right from the tag list, with a choice of the Deck tag colors
- The Note tags panel got a new look
  (for #3841)
  - Tags are shown as rounded chips in their tag color, and can be removed via their ✕ button
  - Clicking a tag shows all notes with that tag in the Tags panel
  - Tags wrap onto more lines instead of needing a horizontal scrollbar
  - Add tag opens a searchable list of all tags, nested tags are shown with their parent tags,
    tags can be toggled and new tags can be created right from the list
  - With multiple notes selected, tags that are only on some of the notes are shown faded
    with a dashed border, and adding them in the tag list adds them to all selected notes
Released files
- QOwnNotes-x86_64.AppImage: Portable Linux AppImage build with Qt 6
- QOwnNotes-x86_64.AppImage.sha256sum: SHA-256 checksum for the AppImage
- QOwnNotes-amd64.snap: Linux Snap build with Qt 6
- QOwnNotes-amd64.snap.sha256sum: SHA-256 checksum for the Qt 6 Snap package
- QOwnNotes.zip: Windows ZIP package built with Qt 6
- QOwnNotes.zip.sha256: SHA-256 checksum for the Qt 6 Windows ZIP package
- QOwnNotes.zip.sha256sum: Alternative SHA-256 checksum file for the Qt 6 Windows ZIP package
- QOwnNotes.msi: Windows installer built with Qt 6
- QOwnNotes.msi.sha256sum: SHA-256 checksum for the Qt 6 Windows installer
- QOwnNotes.dmg: macOS disk image built with Qt 6
- QOwnNotesQt5.dmg: macOS disk image built with Qt 5 for older systems
